articles.title: 'I’ve Been In a Lot of Harry Potter Already' — Daniel Radcliffe Isn't Sure If He'll Watch HBO's Harry Potter TV Series
articles.summary: Former Harry Potter actor Daniel Radcliffe isn't sure if he's going to watch HBO's TV adaptation of the Wizarding World. When speaking with The Associated Press, Radcliffe was asked whether or not he plans to watch HBO's TV series. He gave an honest answer, admitting that he isn't sure if he will.
body: “I haven’t seen Breaking Bad. I haven’t seen Mad Men. I haven’t seen some of the, like, the real classics. So, you know, eight hours is a lot of anything to watch.”

Radcliffe's career is obviously partially defined by Harry Potter. However, he has been very aware that the franchise was bound to be remade and was even quoted back in 2012 about the possibility of such a thing. He was a bit dismissive of the idea at the time, noting he wasn't totally fond of remakes, saying they make unnecessary changes for the sake of doing something different.

Despite this, Radcliffe has been welcoming to the new Potter cast, and even wrote a letter to Dominic McLaughlin, who is playing Harry in the HBO show. He has asked, however, that the press don't badger the new cast about following in the footsteps of the films. Radcliffe told Associated Press he's not interested in giving advice to McLaughlin, as he doesn't want to "haunt" him and has full trust in him as an actor.
points: Former Harry Potter actor Daniel Radcliffe isn't sure if he's going to watch HBO's TV adaptation of the Wizarding World.

articles.title: Skydance Reveals HBO Max and Paramount Plus Streaming Bundle Coming Early 2027
articles.summary: Skydance has announced a subscription bundle for both Paramount+ and HBO Max is coming to viewers as soon as early 2027. Skydance has released some of its first big news off the back of Warner Bros. and Paramount’s merger last month.
body: Going by this letter, it appears a bundle of these two services is the first step in Skydance’s eventual goal of creating an all-new streaming platform that combines both HBO Max and Paramount.

“At Paramount, by the middle of this year, we’ll have completed the consolidation of our three services under one unified stack.” He explained the company’s approach in the months ahead and stated, "We think the combined offering – and given the amount of content and what we can do from the tech side – really will put us in the position to be able to compete with the most scaled players in DTC."

This combination puts offerings like Lanterns and Game of Thrones in the same space as Tulsa King and Lioness, with Variety noting that this makes its service a more viable competitor to the likes of Amazon’s Prime Video and Netflix.

This is the latest big news from Skydance after its gaming division experienced sweeping layoffs as a result of the merger. Projects and roles at Paramount Games Studio — established this summer as a combination of Paramount and Skydance gaming studios — are being “scaled back,” as told in a statement from Skydance that was also released on Monday.

articles.title: Switch 2 Just Had Its Best Sales Week Of 2026, And It’s All Because Of Zelda
articles.summary: Nintendo just released The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's remake for Switch 2, and the themed console that Nintendo debuted with the game has, perhaps unsurprisingly, sold incredibly well.
body: Circana's Mat Piscatella shared new data that confirms the Switch 2 just had its best sales week of 2026 so far, based on dollar sales, thanks to the 40th Anniversary Edition console. The $520 console launched on October 29, and Circana's reporting period for the week ended on October 31.

The special-edition console sports a geometric design inspired by the Zelda series, with a large Triforce symbol on the dock. The accompanying Joy-Cons feature the game's classic green and gold color scheme, along with specific designs based on the RPG series.
The system doesn't include a copy of the game, which launched on November 5, and is priced at $60 digitally and $70 on a physical cartridge.
Sales of the 40th Anniversary Edition console helped lift total spending on hardware in the US for the week by 81% compared to the same week in 2025.

articles.title: Here Are Some Movies to Watch Before GTA 6 (Including Some You Can Watch in Theaters)
articles.summary: We've compiled a list of movies to watch before GTA 6, including some classics that will be shown at Regal Cinemas over the course of the next week.
body: Regal Cinemas is hosting a GTA 6-inspired movie marathon leading up to the game's launch next Thursday. The marathon will kick off at the theater chain this Friday with Spring Breakers, starring Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, and James Franco. Every day until November 18, there will be a new movie showing, including Scarface, 2 Fast 2 Furious, and other beloved Miami-centric films. You can view the full list below.

It's a pretty good list on its own, and they're all great depictions of absurd crime stories in Miami. 2 Fast 2 Furious might not be the most critically acclaimed film, but it is set in Miami, and Paul Walker and Eva Mendes make for a pretty good stand-in for Jason and Lucia. Spring Breakers definitely features the kind of Floridian debauchery you'd expect in a Grand Theft Auto game, while Scarface and Miami Vice are, of course, the bedrock of the original Grand Theft Auto: Vice City game.
If you don't have a Regal Cinema near you or are looking for other recommendations to enjoy at home, we've put together a small watch list for you ahead of GTA 6's launch.

articles.title: GTA 5’s Trevor Should Be In GTA 6 Sitting On The Toilet To “Pass The Torch,” Actor Says
articles.summary: Steven Ogg famously portrayed the wildcard character Trevor in Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 5, and he wishes Rockstar brought the character back for GTA 6. Speaking to Principle Magazine, Ogg said it would have been a nice moment to "pass the torch" to have Trevor show up at the beginning of GTA 6…
body: In short, Ogg said he wanted Trevor to have some kind of "acknowledgement" that Trevor's story is over and it's time for Jason and Lucia to take center stage in GTA 6. Ogg said it could have been a nice full circle moment because, in GTA 5, Trevor's first scene shows him bashing Johnny Klebitz from GTA 4.
"I’m not a fan of all of the reboots and the sequels. I don’t get the … the hunger for that, but there is, because it makes money and that’s why people do it," he said.
Ogg went on to say things have come so far since GTA 5, so he wanted to see how characters from GTA 5 could look in GTA 6, given the technical improvements from the past decade.
"So, I’d be curious. But you know, not my duck, not my bottle. Not my monkey, not my cage," he said.

articles.title: DC Studios Is Getting A Marvel Veteran To Replace James Gunn And Peter Safran
articles.summary: DC Studios co-presidents James Gunn and Peter Safran have officially announced they'll step down, and Marvel veteran Jeremy Latcham will replace them. Gunn and Safran architected the new DC Universe of films and TV series, and they also had ambitious plans to expand the DCU into video games.
body: Following the relaunch of the DC Universe in film, Gunn later spoke about the potential of cross-platform storytelling, saying actors would portray their characters across all forms of media—including video games. "We have a couple of little DC games coming out. But we also have talked about–and in early stages of planning--some bigger things," Gunn said in 2025. "One thing in particular I’m excited about, but it does take time."

We never got to hear David Corenswet reprise his role as Superman in a video game, and since then, big changes have happened behind the scenes. Paramount’s $111 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery was approved earlier this year, leading to a merger between Warner Bros. Interactive (the WB division that publishes video games based on the company's IP) and Paramount Games Studio.

articles.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Gives Its Best Boy the Happy Ending He Deserved Decades Ago
articles.summary: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a mostly faithful remake, true, but there's a generous handful of tweaks and expansions that fill out this version of Hyrule beautifully. Most of those changes are grim.
body: Richard is a dog, a very good dog. You might even say the best dog. Though even if you didn't, his owner, Mamamu Yan, certainly would. She lives in Castle Town at the start of the game, and her favorite things to do are watch Richard play and talk about how much she loves Richard. It's cute! Less cute when she's rude about the town's other dogs, but no pup can choose their owner, I guess. It's not Richard's fault. He's a blameless angel.
A weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

In the Switch 2 Ocarina of Time remake, Richard lives! He's alive and well, frolicking happily around Kakariko Village during the daytime and remaining decidedly un-lost at night. Little guy obviously learned his lesson back in Castle Town. Anyway, I originally thought maybe Mamamu Yan was one of those people who names every pet the same thing. Maybe this was Richard the Third or something. But no, it's the same wonderful little fuzzball from before. Mamamu Yan waxes at length about the virtues and splendor of her Richard, with no mention of ancestors or dead Richards or anything of that kind.
points: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a mostly faithful remake, true, but there's a generous handful of tweaks and expansions that fill out this version of Hyrule beautifully.

body: That's not the only song people are recreating in the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, though. On Reddit, a person posted the child Hylian playing the intro to Linkin Park's "In the End." articles.title: As investors ask about GTA 6 and AI, Take-Two CEO once again puts faith in dev creativity, states making hit games "remains the purview of human beings"
articles.summary: Today, as part of Take-Two Interactive Software's Q2 2027 earnings call, Strauss Zelnick fielded questions from investors after presenting the financial results of the company.
body: Zelnick notes that "[the video games] business has been largely immune to piracy" thanks to factors like file size, how console ecosystems work, and aspects related to the online nature of the games industry. That said, Strauss continues, there is a threat posed to the industry because of AI. However, he assures listening investors that Take-Two is appropriately scaling its measures against bad faith actors using artificial intelligence.

"We are utterly focused on enhancing our technical defences and enhancing our legal activities appropriately. And - at the same time, without in any way being cavalier - every entertainment business that exists is subject to some element of piracy, [and] this is likely to invade our business to a greater or lesser extent. I think it will be manageable and we are focused on it."

Zelnick pivots back to AI again later in the call, where one investor once again asks about AI, seemingly keen to learn whether the CEO feels it can provide GTA 6 developer Rockstar with any kind of "competitive advantage" in the games industry. Given Zelnick's previous comments on the subject, his answer was not a complete surprise.

articles.title: GTA 6 pre-orders are tracking "well above expectations" and the game will "set a new baseline" for Take-Two, says CEO Strauss Zelnick
articles.summary: Today, as part of Take-Two Interactive Software's Q2 2027 earnings call, Strauss Zelnick noted that pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto 6 are tracking "far above expectations", and is certain that soon "numbers will speak for themselves" when it comes to the game.
body: Zelnick also promised GTA Online and GTA 5 will continue to receive updates in order to support the "nearly 235 million" units sold to date across "an unprecedented three console generations". The GTA series as a whole has, to date, sold over 480 million units. Karl Statoff, president at Take-Two, adds the launch of GTA 6 will be a "defining moment for the company and global entertainment industry". Zelnick adds, later in a question and answer session, that he expects GTA 6 to "set a new baseline" for Take-Two. "The future's really bright across the board," he notes.

For the next quarter, Take-Two expects to deliver $3.35 billion to $3.5 billion - with "recurrent consumer spending" to raise by 12 percent, driven by "the groundbreaking release" of Grand Theft Auto 6, and expects to see "significant growth for the Grand Theft Auto series", driven by sales of - specifically - Grand Theft Auto 6's Ultimate Edition, which includes add-on content, and that most people are pre-ordering at its $100 price point. That bonus $20 between the $80 base edition and the Ultimate Edition is counted as "recurrent consumer spending", as is part of that massive bump the company has seen.

articles.title: "Something's really possible" - Mass Effect cast rally around efforts to save the franchise on the first N7 Day after BioWare's closure
articles.summary: This N7 Day was the first without developer BioWare around, but fans of the Mass Effect series didn't let 7th November go by quietly. The community managed to get several notable Mass Effect actors to lend their voice to the increasingly loud 'SaveMassEffect' movement.
body: In the weeks since BioWare's shock closure and Mass Effect Universe's cancellation, the community-organised We Are Mass Effect group have put up billboards in Times Square, a mobile billboard outside BioWare Edmonton's former office and much more while directing attention to an online petition.

And for the series' annual celebration, the group managed to get a sizable portion of the Mass Effect cast to join in. Commander Shepard actors Jennifer Hale and Mark Meer, original trilogy composer Sam Hulick, Garrus' Brandon Keener, Jack's Courtnay Taylor, Tali'Zorah's Ash Sroka, Thane's Keythe Farley and many more all showed up in a two-minute video to help potentially salvage the series - sometimes in character.

The other half of Commander Shepard, Mark Meer, noted that "this didn't all just happen in the last 10 days." Near yearly layoffs at EA had slowly trimmed multiple BioWare teams down, sometimes even affecting studio veterans who had been at the company for decades.
points: This N7 Day was the first without developer BioWare around, but fans of the Mass Effect series didn't let 7th November go by quietly.

articles.title: HBO Max-Paramount Plus Bundle Officially Confirmed for 2027
articles.summary: HBO Max and Paramount Plus are officially joining forces, with a new streaming bundle set to launch in early 2027. Skydance Corporation, which completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery in October, confirmed the plans in its third-quarter shareholder letter on Monday.
body: The company pointed to several recent successes on both platforms in the letter.

On Paramount Plus, Lioness saw its viewership increase by 62% during its third season, while MobLand became the platform's biggest original series ever in the U.K. and Ireland with its second installment. HBO Max, meanwhile, has found success with its DC and fantasy programming. Skydance highlighted Lanterns and House of the Dragon season 3 as two of the platform's strongest launches and returning seasons ever, averaging 22 million and 42 million global viewers, respectively.

The company is also working toward integrating the technology behind its streaming services. Skydance said it expects to align the backend systems for Paramount Plus and HBO Max within a year of closing the Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition, potentially paving the way for a more unified streaming experience.
